_doc: Wall traps, after Stronghold's killing grounds: laid before a section of the drawn wall (section 0 is the gate). In a siege, every wave that comes at a section loses 'cut' of its ground troops to each trap there that is ready; fliers pass over. A trap with 'once' is spent when it goes off and wants 'refill' gold to lay again. 'gatehouse' traps need the gatehouse and go only at the gate.

kinds.name: Pitch ditch
kinds.tip: A ditch of pitch and straw before the wall. Lit when the first wave reaches it.
kinds.text: The pitch ditch before the {place} goes up under them. Burning, they fall back.

kinds.name: Caltrops
kinds.tip: Iron spikes strewn in the grass. Every wave at this wall limps.
kinds.text: Caltrops in the grass before the {place} lame the front ranks.

kinds.name: Wolf pits
kinds.tip: Staked pits under turf. They take the first wave at this wall.
kinds.text: The turf before the {place} gives way. The first rank goes down onto the stakes.

kinds.name: Murder holes
kinds.tip: Holes in the gatehouse vault for rocks, arrows and boiling water. Every wave at the gate.
kinds.text: Rocks and boiling water come down through the murder holes on whoever reaches the gate.

texts.refilled: The ditches are dug out and filled with pitch again: {gold} gold.
